hook: Pilot-scale algae culture yielded 157.7 mg of a 33-stereocenter polyketide whose structure was fully assigned.

readout.label: Amphidiketol A obtained from Amphidinium sp.

summary: Giant marine polyketides have been hard to study because samples are scarce and floppy molecules resist structure assignment. Growing dinoflagellates at pilot scale gave over 100 mg of compounds, and a fragment-by-fragment method fixed the 33 stereocenters of amphidiketol A. Nine protein targets in lung cancer cells were identified, but biological effects were not shown beyond cell lines.
title: Integrating biomass production platform and identification approach for stereochemical assignment of super-carbon-chain compounds.
